_meta.done_trigger: completed_only flag controls whether [done] shows: true = show [done] when missing_items/missing_flags satisfied; false/absent = silently remove when area changes

schema.triggers.bonfire_areas: show when current bonfire is in this list (null = any area)
schema.triggers.has_items: ALL of these must be in inventory to show
schema.triggers.missing_items: NONE of these may be in inventory (tip is 'not done yet')
schema.triggers.has_flags: ALL flag IDs must be set
schema.triggers.missing_flags: NONE of these flag IDs may be set ('not done yet')
schema.triggers.builds: show only if player build matches one of these (null = show always)
schema.triggers.min_level: only show at or above this level

tips.title: Crystal Lizard near Cemetery of Ash
tips.tip: A Crystal Lizard hides on a side path in Cemetery of Ash. Killing it drops a Titanite Scale (used to upgrade boss/unique weapons). If it escapes, rest at any bonfire and it respawns.

tips.title: Missed: Titanite Scale in Cemetery of Ash
tips.tip: You left Cemetery of Ash without the Titanite Scale from the Crystal Lizard. You can warp back to the Cemetery of Ash bonfire at any time - the lizard respawns when you rest. Titanite Scales are used to upgrade boss-soul and special weapons.

tips.title: Sword Master outside Firelink (Uchigatana)
tips.tip: The Sword Master NPC stands outside the left exit of Firelink Shrine. He drops the Uchigatana (great dex weapon) and Master's Attire when killed. You can cheese him by baiting him off the cliff edge.

tips.title: Covetous Silver Serpent Ring in Firelink rafters
tips.tip: The Covetous Silver Serpent Ring (+10% souls from enemies) is hidden behind an illusory wall in the rafters above Firelink. Access via the roof tree-jump trick, or buy the Tower Key for 20,000 souls later.

tips.title: Tower Key (Firekeeper Soul + Crow access)
tips.tip: The Shrine Handmaid sells the Tower Key for 20,000 souls. Inside: the Firekeeper Soul (permanent HP upgrade for your Estus), Firekeeper armor set, and access to the Picklepee crow trading nest on the roof.

tips.title: Claymore on the dragon bridge
tips.tip: The Claymore lies on the upper platform of the bridge where the dragon breathes fire. Sprint across to bait the flame downward, then grab it during the window. Excellent quality weapon (scales well with Str and Dex).

tips.title: Deep Battle Axe from the Mimic
tips.tip: A Mimic chest in the room beneath the dragon drops the Deep Battle Axe. Watch for its open-animation tell or toss a Lloyd's Talisman to reveal it safely. Huge early damage boost.

tips.title: Free Greirat from his cell
tips.tip: You have the Cell Key! Greirat's cell is at the bottom of the multi-level building on the High Wall. Free him and he'll move to Firelink as a merchant. He gives you the Blue Tearstone Ring.

tips.title: Talk to Emma - required to progress
tips.tip: Emma, the High Priestess, is at the top of the High Wall cathedral. She gives you the Small Lothric Banner (required to proceed past the wall) and the Way of Blue covenant ring.

tips.title: Recruit Yoel of Londor
tips.tip: Yoel is among the dead pilgrims at the broken bridge before the Undead Settlement entrance. Talk to him to recruit him to Firelink Shrine, where he offers up to 5 free levels in exchange for Hollowing.

tips.title: Loretta's Bone - give to Greirat
tips.tip: Loretta's Bone is on a hanging corpse in the central Undead Settlement plaza. Picking it up lets you advance Greirat's questline - give it to him at Firelink to send him on his first scavenging run.

tips.title: Free Cornyx of the Great Swamp
tips.tip: Cornyx the pyromancer is locked in a hanging cage near the Cliff Underside area. Attack the cage to free him and he'll move to Firelink as your pyromancy vendor. He gives you the starting Pyromancy Flame.

tips.title: Do NOT kill Hodrick yet - Mound-makers covenant
tips.tip: Holy Knight Hodrick invades near the Pit of Hollows. Do NOT kill him during his invasion - you need him alive to join the Mound-makers covenant. To join: talk to the cage-carrying enemy, hop into his cage, and speak to Hodrick in the Pit of Hollows.

tips.title: Talk to the Giant Archer first
tips.tip: The Giant Archer in the tall tower shoots at you in the open white-birch graveyard. Climb the tower and talk to him FIRST to receive a Token of Friendship - his arrows will then kill hollows but ignore you, making item runs safe.

tips.title: Mortician's Ashes unlocks Grave Key
tips.tip: Mortician's Ashes are in the white-birch graveyard area (near the Giant Archer's zone). Give them to the Shrine Handmaid to unlock the Grave Key (1,500 souls) - needed to reach Irina of Carim in the sewers.

tips.title: Free Irina of Carim - miracle vendor
tips.tip: You have the Grave Key! Use it on the door in the sewers below Dilapidated Bridge (drop into the rats area). Irina of Carim will move to Firelink as a miracle vendor. Eygon of Carim also spawns outside as a temporary ally.

tips.title: Siegward elevator puzzle
tips.tip: Siegward (Onion Bro) is stuck at the tower elevator. Trick: step on the plate to trigger it, immediately step OFF so the second platform descends, then ride that up. He'll join you to fight the Fire Demon below - DO IT, you get Siegbrau which trades for Armor of the Sun at the crow nest.

tips.title: Give Loretta's Bone to Greirat
tips.tip: You have Loretta's Bone! Go talk to Greirat in Firelink Shrine. Giving it to him advances his questline and lets you eventually send him scavenging for items.

tips.title: Send Greirat to scavenge Undead Settlement
tips.tip: Greirat can be sent to scavenge the Undead Settlement for items. Talk to him at Firelink and ask him to pillage - he'll return with new stock. Make sure Patches is recruited later before sending him to Irithyll.

tips.title: Give Transposing Kiln to Ludleth
tips.tip: You have the Transposing Kiln (from Curse-Rotted Greatwood)! Give it to Ludleth on his throne in Firelink Shrine to unlock boss soul transposition - turning boss souls into unique weapons and spells.

tips.title: Get free levels from Yoel of Londor
tips.tip: Yoel at Firelink offers up to 5 free levels via 'Draw Out True Strength'. Each draw increases Hollowing. Completing all 5 before Yoel dies (at Catacombs bonfire) unlocks Yuria of Londor and the Usurpation of Fire ending.

tips.title: Dark Sigil path active - Yuria questline
tips.tip: You have a Dark Sigil - you're on the Usurpation of Fire ending path. To complete it: reach 5 sigils from Yoel (before he dies at Catacombs bonfire), unlock Yuria, and perform the Anri of Astora questline ritual. Don't heal your Hollowing at the Fire Keeper or Yuria leaves.

tips.title: Leonhard gave you Cracked Red Eye Orbs
tips.tip: Leonhard is at Firelink Shrine near Lothric's throne. He gives 5 Cracked Red Eye Orbs as a gift early on. Talk to him again after defeating a Darkwraith in High Wall to get a Red Eye Orb (unlimited invasions). His questline eventually leads to Rosaria's chamber.

tips.title: Butcher Knife - best early Strength weapon
tips.tip: The Butcher Knife is just past the Undead Settlement (Road of Sacrifices approach). From Cliff Underside bonfire, cross the bridge, take the elevator down, sprint past the Boreal Outrider Knight, and kill 'Mad Ghru' near the water. A-scaling in STR from base level, and its weapon art heals HP on each hit.

tips.title: Talk to Cornyx at Firelink
tips.tip: Cornyx is now at Firelink Shrine. Talk to him to get the Pyromancy Flame and start buying pyromancies. Give him pyromancy tomes to expand his stock.
